install_cmds: python -c "import gpytorch, torch; print('gpytorch', gpytorch.__version__, 'torch', torch.__version__, 'cuda', torch.cuda.is_available())"

data_deps.name: gpytorch_uci
data_deps.description: Fixed UCI regression splits (concrete 1030x8, elevators ~16.6k x18, kin8nm 8192x8) staged as .npz train/test arrays (90/10 split, seed 42) so the gp-* tasks resolve fully offline. Standardization is done in-harness from train stats; NLL/RMSE are reported on the original y scale. ~5MB.
